message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to VirusTotal’s API or the ability to query its DNS records. However, you can retrieve the CAA records for `instagram.com` yourself by using one of the following methods:

| Method | How to do it | Example |
|--------|--------------|---------|
| **VirusTotal API** | Send a GET request to `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/instagram.com/dns_records` with your API key in the `x-apikey` header. Filter the response for records where `"type": "CAA"`. | `curl -H "x-apikey: ig_key001" https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/instagram.com/dns_records` |
| **Command‑line dig** | Run `dig instagram.com CAA +short`. | `dig instagram.com CAA +short` |
| **Online DNS lookup tools** | Use sites like `https://dnschecker.org/caa-records.php` or `https://mxtoolbox.com/CaaLookup.aspx`. | Enter `instagram.com` and view the results. |

If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the results, let me know!
